subtitle: The Little Prince lives on the asteroid B-664 for the sake of a rose he loves. One day, upon learning that the rose is in danger, the Little Prince sets off on a long journey along the galaxy to save the rose. However, the Little Prince's spaceship isn't in great shape, so he must travel while avoiding transitions between planetary systems as much as possible. The image below shows part of the galaxy map the Little Prince has unfolded.
